effect.en: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.

flavor.en: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.
flavor.ko: 자신의 HP를 조금 깎아서 분신을 만든다. 분신은 자신의 대타가 된다.
